form:FormGroup.label: Id
form:FormGroup.helpText: Unique ID of this component on the dashboard, generated when the component is added (e.g. table-filter-AB1C2). It cannot be changed.

form:FormGroup.label: Name
form:FormGroup.helpText: Name of this component, shown in its tab on the dashboard.

form:FormGroup.label: Table
form:FormGroup.helpText: Table or embedded query whose columns this filter acts on.

form:FormGroup.label: Columns To Display
form:FormGroup.helpText: Columns of the selected table to show value filters for. Tick each column you want users to filter on.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Tick the columns to show filters for.
